n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize combination array C
N = 505
C = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

def add(a, b):
    return a + b if a + b < mod else a + b - mod

def mul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % mod

def get(i):
    return i * (i + 1) // 2

way = [0] * (N)
sum_arr = [0] * (N)
way[0] = 1

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        way[i] = add(way[i], mul(mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j]), mul(way[j], way[i - j - 1])))
        sum_arr[i] = add(sum_arr[i], mul(mul(add(get(j), get(i - j - 1)), way[j]), way[i - j - 1]))
        sum_arr[i] = add(sum_arr[i], mul(mul(i + 1, add(mul(sum_arr[j], way[i - j - 1]), mul(way[j], sum_arr[i - j - 1]))), C[i - 1][j]))

n += 1
# Initialize DP arrays
f = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(n + 1)]
g = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(n + 1)]
f[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(m - j + 1):
            if i + k + 1 <= n:
                f[i + k + 1][j + k] = add(f[i + k + 1][j + k], mul(mul(f[i][j], way[k]), C[j + k][j]))
                g[i + k + 1][j + k] = add(g[i + k + 1][j + k], mul(add(mul(f[i][j], sum_arr[k]), mul(g[i][j], way[k])), C[j + k][j]))

print(g[n][m])
